_comment: BitBot's settings for GameCreator's survivor.js frame loop (GC_SURVIVOR_PROFILE). reaction and cursorMoveFrames are BitBot's own defaults (12 frames, travel.MOVE_FRAMES 4) and set how survivor.js walks and presses for it; ahead is how far ahead it may ask a decision. weights/depth/modes are required by the loader but unused: bot/bitbot_mind.js decides with bitbot.js's own STARTER vector.
name: BitBot
